title: Validate reported “silly errors” and keep code/design unchanged (no code diff)
body:
The request was to eliminate bugs without changing design or touching unrelated code. After reproducing the code paths and running the repository’s existing checks, no actionable defects were found in the current branch, so no source changes were introduced.

- **Scope alignment**
  - Kept the implementation and UI/design untouched as requested.
  - Avoided speculative edits in absence of a reproducible failure.

- **Code changes**
  - No files were modified.
  - No behavior changes were introduced.

```bash
# Current branch result: no failing tests, no syntax failures
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python tests/test_float.py
python -m compileall -q .
```
